description: This PHP class 'OAuthCodeGrantManager' manages OAuth2 authorization request sessions, including saving, loading, validating, and cleaning up session data related to OAuth2 authorization code grants within SuiteCRM.

classes.name: OAuthCodeGrantManager
classes.description: Manages OAuth2 authorization code grant sessions, including saving request data to session, loading authorization requests, session cleanup, and validation of confirmation requests.

methods.name: saveRequestToSession
methods.description: Stores OAuth2 authorization request parameters into PHP session variables.

methods.name: loadAuthorizationRequest
methods.description: Retrieves and reconstructs an OAuth2 authorization request from session data, validating it with the authorization server.

methods.name: cleanupSession
methods.description: Removes OAuth2 authorization-related data from the session.

methods.name: validateConfirmationRequest
methods.description: Validates the OAuth2 confirmation request by checking session and request parameters for consistency and authenticity.

methods.name: getQueryParam
methods.description: Helper method to safely retrieve a query parameter from the request.
